```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Anchor: direct components of the target model under current BOM
    SELECT 
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM company_model cm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'ER4-180OAK69-0166'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive step: explode assembly components
    SELECT 
        cb.child_component_id,
        bt.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bt.component_id AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = bt.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bt.total_qty), 0) AS total_units_needed
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = bt.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'GEA-219-WAL-02353';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
bom_tree(component_id, total_qty, is_assembly) AS (
    SELECT
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mb.component_id
    WHERE mb.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'VI4-180BLK96-0484')
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        cb.child_component_id,
        bt.total_qty * cb.qty,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = bt.component_id
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = cb.child_component_id
    WHERE bt.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
```

```sql
    -- Direct: non-bundle SKU mapping to the target model

    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing li ON li.listing_id = ol.listing_id

    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'

    UNION ALL

    -- Via bundle: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> target model
    SELECT ol.qty * bi.qty * sm.qty AS line_model_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing li ON li.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku bundle ON bundle.sku_id = li.sku_id AND bundle.is_bundle = TRUE
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = bundle.sku_id

    JOIN target_model tm ON tm.model_id = sm.model_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: order lines → listing → SKU → (bundle items) → SKU-model → model BOM
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.qty AS ol_qty,
        COALESCE(bi.qty, 1) AS bundle_qty,
        sm.qty AS sku_model_qty,
        mb.qty AS path_qty,
        mb.component_id AS component_id,
        o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing li ON li.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON sku.sku_id = li.sku_id
    LEFT JOIN bundle_item bi
        ON bi.bundle_sku_id = sku.sku_id
        AND sku.is_bundle = true
    JOIN sku_model sm
        ON sm.sku_id = COALESCE(bi.item_sku_id, sku.sku_id)
    JOIN model_bom mb
        ON mb.model_id = sm.model_id
        AND mb.valid_from <= o.order_date
        AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store WHERE store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14')
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive step: expand assembly components using component BOM valid on the order date
    SELECT
        e.order_id,
        e.line_no,
        e.ol_qty,
        e.bundle_qty,
        e.sku_model_qty,
        e.path_qty * cb.qty AS path_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        e.order_date
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = e.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb
        ON cb.parent_component_id = e.component_id
        AND cb.valid_from <= e.order_date

    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
)
```

```sql
    FROM order_lines
    WHERE is_bundle = false
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id AS leaf_sku_id,
        bi.qty AS bundle_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ol.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = true
),
model_bom_exploded AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.order_id,
        ls.order_date,
        ls.line_no,
        ls.line_qty::BIGINT * ls.bundle_qty::BIGINT * sm.qty::BIGINT * mb.qty::BIGINT AS total_qty,
        mb.component_id
    FROM leaf_skus ls
    JOIN sku_model sm ON ls.leaf_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= ls.order_date
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR ls.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),
bom_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        order_date,
        line_no,
        total_qty,
        component_id
    FROM model_bom_exploded
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        bt.order_id,
        bt.order_date,
        bt.line_no,
        bt.total_qty * cb.qty::BIGINT AS total_qty,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN component c ON bt.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON c.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= bt.order_date
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR bt.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bt.total_qty), 0)::BIGINT AS consumed_units
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN component c ON bt.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'LEG-862-GRY-00374'
  AND c.is_assembly = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_to_model AS (
    -- Base: non-bundle SKU maps directly to company model
    SELECT 
        s.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = FALSE

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive: bundle SKU -> item SKU, propagate model mapping and multiply qty
    SELECT 
        s.sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        uc.qty * sm.model_qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sku_to_model sm 
        ON sm.sku_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = TRUE
)
SELECT 
    sm.model_code
FROM orders o
JOIN store st 
    ON st.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN order_line ol 
    ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN listing l 
    ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN sales_sku s 
    ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
JOIN sku_to_model sm 
    ON sm.sku_code = s.sku_code
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND st.country = 'JP'
  AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY sm.model_code
```

```sql
      AND u.child_kind = 'model'

    UNION ALL

    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU (possibly nested) -> model
    SELECT 
        u.parent_code AS sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        u.qty * sm.factor AS factor
    FROM u_composition u
    JOIN sku_model sm ON u.child_code = sm.sku_code
    WHERE u.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND u.child_kind = 'sku'
)
SELECT 
    sm.model_code
FROM order_line ol
JOIN listing li ON ol.listing_id = li.listing_id
JOIN sales_sku ss ON li.sku_id = ss.sku_id
JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
JOIN sku_model sm ON ss.sku_code = sm.sku_code
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
  AND st.country = 'DE'
GROUP BY sm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(ol.qty * sm.factor) DESC, sm.model_code ASC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_model AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs map directly to models
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code AS sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty,
        uc.valid_from,
        uc.valid_to
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN sales_sku p ON p.sku_code = uc.parent_code AND p.is_bundle = FALSE
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.child_kind = 'model'

    UNION ALL

    -- Bundle SKUs map to item SKUs which then map to models
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code AS sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        uc.qty * sm.model_qty AS model_qty,
        CASE 
            WHEN sm.valid_from IS NULL THEN uc.valid_from
            WHEN uc.valid_from IS NULL THEN sm.valid_from
            ELSE GREATEST(uc.valid_from, sm.valid_from)
        END AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL THEN sm.valid_to
            WHEN sm.valid_to IS NULL THEN uc.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(uc.valid_to, sm.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN sku_model sm 
        ON uc.child_code = sm.sku_code 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    JOIN sales_sku p 
        ON p.sku_code = uc.parent_code 
        AND p.is_bundle = TRUE
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
)
SELECT 
    sm.model_code
FROM orders o
JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN listing li ON ol.listing_id = li.listing_id
JOIN sales_sku s ON li.sku_id = s.sku_id
JOIN sku_model sm ON s.sku_code = sm.sku_code
JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND st.country = 'DE'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  AND o.order_date >= sm.valid_from
  AND (sm.valid_to IS NULL OR o.order_date <= sm.valid_to)
GROUP BY sm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(ol.qty * sm.model_qty) DESC
LIMIT 3
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE jp_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
),
order_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        jo.order_id,
        jo.order_date,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        sk.sku_code
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN jp_orders jo ON jo.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing li ON li.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = li.sku_id
),
bom_paths AS (
    SELECT 
        os.order_id,
        os.order_date,
        os.line_qty,
        os.sku_code AS node_code,
        'sku' AS node_kind,
        1 AS factor
    FROM order_skus os
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        bp.order_id,
        bp.order_date,
        bp.line_qty,
        uc.child_code AS node_code,
        uc.child_kind AS node_kind,
        bp.factor * uc.qty AS factor
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN u_composition uc
      ON uc.parent_kind = bp.node_kind
     AND uc.parent_code = bp.node_code
    WHERE bp.node_kind = 'sku'
      AND uc.child_kind IN ('sku', 'model')
      AND uc.valid_from <= bp.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR bp.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
)
SELECT 
    cm.model_code
FROM bom_paths bp
JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_code = bp.node_code
WHERE bp.node_kind = 'model'
GROUP BY cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(bp.line_qty * bp.factor) DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: direct components of the model on the given date
    SELECT
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        CAST(c.qty AS BIGINT) AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'TE1-180WAL91-0673'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2023-07-13'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2023-07-13')

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive step: expand assembly components
    SELECT
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        e.total_qty * CAST(c.qty AS BIGINT) AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN component p ON p.component_code = e.component_code AND p.is_assembly = true
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'component'
                        AND c.parent_code = e.component_code
                        AND c.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2023-07-13'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2023-07-13')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.total_qty), 0) AS total_part_units
FROM bom_explosion e
JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = e.component_code
WHERE comp.is_assembly = false;
```
